<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Fruit Ninja</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#1f2a1a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1f2a1aee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;width:min(90vw,340px)}
button{background:#f97316;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700}button:disabled{background:#3a4a33;color:#8aa07f}
</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=20,K='mg_fruit',T='🍉 Fruit Ninja',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Vuốt ngón tay để chém trái cây, tránh bom 💣':'Giữ chuột và rê để chém trái cây, tránh bom 💣';
let W,H,U,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight;U=Math.min(W,H*.8)*.09}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w){if(!run)return;run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);lt=t;if(run){upd(d);draw()}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
const FR=['🍉','🍊','🍎','🍋','🍇','🍓'];let F,P,tr,lf,sc,goal,tm,dn=0,lp;
function init(){F=[];P=[];tr=[];lf=5;sc=0;goal=10+lv*3;tm=0}
function spawn(){const x=W*(.15+Math.random()*.7),hh=H*(.55+Math.random()*.3),vy=-Math.sqrt(2*H*1.2*hh),t=-2*vy/(H*1.2);F.push({x,y:H+U,vy,vx:(W/2-x)/t*Math.random()*1.2,b:lv>1&&Math.random()<Math.min(.08+lv*.01,.25),e:FR[Math.random()*6|0]})}
function dst(p,a,b){const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/l));return Math.hypot(p.x-a.x-t*dx,p.y-a.y-t*dy)}
function cut(a,b){F.forEach(o=>{if(!o.s&&dst(o,a,b)<U*.7){o.s=1;if(o.b){lf--;P.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,vx:0,e:'💥',tl:.5})}else{sc++;P.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,vx:-U*3,e:o.e,tl:.4},{x:o.x,y:o.y,vx:U*3,e:o.e,tl:.4})}}})}
function upd(d){tm-=d;if(tm<=0){tm=Math.max(.9-lv*.025,.3)*(.6+Math.random()*.8);spawn();if(lv>6&&Math.random()<.4)spawn()}
F.forEach(o=>{o.vy+=H*1.2*d;o.x+=o.vx*d;o.y+=o.vy*d;if(!o.s&&o.y>H+U&&o.vy>0){o.s=1;if(!o.b)lf--}});F=F.filter(o=>!o.s);
P.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx*d;p.y+=H*.5*d;p.tl-=d});P=P.filter(p=>p.tl>0);
if(lf<=0)end(0);else if(sc>=goal)end(1)}
function draw(){C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);C.font=U+'px serif';C.textAlign='center';C.textBaseline='middle';
F.forEach(o=>C.fillText(o.b?'💣':o.e,o.x,o.y));P.forEach(p=>{C.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.tl*2.5);C.fillText(p.e,p.x,p.y)});C.globalAlpha=1;
const n=performance.now();tr=tr.filter(p=>n-p.t<180);if(tr.length>1){C.strokeStyle='#fff';C.lineWidth=5;C.lineCap='round';C.beginPath();tr.forEach((p,i)=>i?C.lineTo(p.x,p.y):C.moveTo(p.x,p.y));C.stroke()}
h.textContent=`Màn ${lv} · 🍉 ${sc}/${goal} · ❤️ ${lf}`}
c.onpointerdown=e=>{dn=1;lp={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}};
c.onpointermove=e=>{if(!dn||!run)return;const q={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};tr.push({x:q.x,y:q.y,t:performance.now()});cut(lp,q);lp=q};
onpointerup=onpointercancel=()=>dn=0;
menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
